active-retail-options-traders.problem: Learn options properly: a paid course or structured program
active-retail-options-traders.note: New step. Price guide shows Udemy/Coursera courses at $20 to $99 and mid-range programs at $500 to $1,000; mid-range copied. Free courses exist, but serious traders commonly pay for a program before or soon after they start.

active-retail-options-traders.problem: See trade ideas and learn from others: paid Discord or alert service

active-retail-options-traders.note: New step. TradingView Essential plan price seen in a StockBrokers.com review; nearly every active trader pays for charting or data beyond the free broker feed.

active-retail-options-traders.problem: Visualise and manage option positions (options analytics tool)
active-retail-options-traders.note: Kept from old ladder step 2. Distinct purchase from charting: it models spreads, Greeks and P&L.

active-retail-options-traders.problem: Find out why the account is bleeding: trade journal and analytics
active-retail-options-traders.note: New step. TraderSync lowest tier price from a StockBrokers.com review; Tradervue is priced the same. Bought after months of inconsistent results.

active-retail-options-traders.problem: Trade other people's capital: funded-trader evaluation fee
active-retail-options-traders.note: Kept from old ladder step 4, now priced. Result says monthly evaluation fees for funded options accounts typically range $50 to $300, starting as low as $32.50.

active-retail-options-traders.problem: File taxes on hundreds of trades and wash sales: trader tax software or CPA
active-retail-options-traders.note: New step. TradeLog price seen in a best-of list (the vendor page hides prices behind login). Bites at the first tax season after a full year of active trading.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: New step. QuickBooks Online Simple Start after the August 2026 price rise. The most common recurring software cost for this room.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.problem: Insure the business: general liability policy
small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: New step. MoneyGeek 2026 benchmark for a general liability policy; landlords, clients and licences usually force this purchase.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.problem: Get found by customers online: local SEO, Google profile and listings
small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: Replaces old step 2 (AI-assistant visibility tool at $95 per month). Local SEO retainers are the broader, established spend; AI-answer visibility is now sold as part of them.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.problem: Answer every call without hiring: AI receptionist or answering service
File business taxes: CPA or tax preparer
small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: New step. Range for small business CPA fees; tax-return projects in the same result start around $1,200. Recurs every year.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.problem: Hire the first employees: payroll service
small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: New step. Gusto Simple plan price from the vendor pricing page. Triggered by the first hire, usually in years 1 to 3.

small-business-owners-reddit-community.problem: Value the business before a sale or a partner buy-in

small-business-owners-reddit-community.note: Kept from old ladder step 4. Only a minority reach this rung within 3 years, but it is the largest single payment.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Find and screen sites: siting and land-data software
solar-wind-project-developers.note: New step. PVcase (Prospect, formerly Anderson Optimization) publishes no price; the review reports industry-observed enterprise deals at this level. LandGate also sells developer subscriptions with no public price. Moderate confidence in attribution.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Buy solar or wind resource data for pre-feasibility
solar-wind-project-developers.note: New step. Solargis Prospect Basic plan from the vendor pricing page (Professional is EUR 3,600 per year). Every project needs bankable-grade resource data before design and financing.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: License PV or wind design and yield software
solar-wind-project-developers.note: Kept from old ladder step 1. Wind equivalent seen in the same task: windPRO BASIS module EUR 1,700.00 standard license (https://www.emd-international.com/software/windpro/pricing).

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Enter the grid interconnection queue: application fee and study deposits
solar-wind-project-developers.note: New step. MISO flat non-refundable D1 application fee effective June 2026; study deposits on top ($8,000 per MW at MISO; PJM $10,000 plus $100 per MW). US figures, but every grid operator charges study fees.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Clear permitting: Phase I environmental site assessment and studies
solar-wind-project-developers.note: New step. Per-parcel Phase I ESA price; utility-scale sites with many parcels run to $20,000 or more. Almost all conditional use permits and lenders require it.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Learn renewables project finance modelling to raise debt
solar-wind-project-developers.note: Kept from old ladder step 3. Paid by individuals to move into or up in development and finance roles.

solar-wind-project-developers.problem: Get a lender-grade energy yield report and independent engineer review to reach financial close
solar-wind-project-developers.note: Kept from old ladder step 4 (was unpriced), narrowed to the yield report. Result: bid-stage PVsyst reports from about $1,500, lender-grade reports on utility-scale projects $15,000 or more. Old step 2 (NABCEP certification, $375) dropped: it is an installer credential, a different room.
